:100: The *Invite your travel arranger* experiment for self-bookers is full-on
*The Impact:*
• *+9.5 bookings/day* (10.4 : 1 odds in favor of variant)
• *3.5%* of new self-bookers clicked "Send Invite"
*The Takeaway:* Scoping the prompt strictly to onboarding drove more engagement.
